endpoint.name: Create / Update Category Bids For Campaign
endpoint.summary: Create or update category bids for a campaign
endpoint.description: Creates or updates the category bid settings for a campaign. When mode=MANUAL, the category_bids array is required. When mode=AUTO, the category_bids array is forbidden.

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: Osmos generated unique identifier for the onboarded advertiser.

mode.description: When MANUAL, the category_bids array is required. When AUTO, the category_bids array is forbidden.

category_bids.description: List of category bids. Required when mode=MANUAL; forbidden when mode=AUTO.

bid_value.description: Bid value for this category. Must be greater than 0 when is_active=true; must be null when is_active=false.

is_active.description: Whether this category bid is active.

200.description: Category bids created or updated successfully
